items.original: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
items.translation_zh: 我走进树林，因为我想有意识地生活。
items.author: Henry David Thoreau

items.original: Flux and change are constantly renewing the world.
items.translation_zh: 流动与变化不断更新着世界。
items.author: Marcus Aurelius

items.original: The sun is but a morning star.
items.translation_zh: 太阳也不过是一颗晨星。
items.author: Henry David Thoreau

items.original: Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
items.translation_zh: 除了你自己，没有什么能带来内在的平静。
items.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

items.original: To see a World in a Grain of Sand.
items.translation_zh: 在一粒沙中看见一个世界。
items.author: William Blake

items.original: 'Tis not too late to seek a newer world.
items.translation_zh: 寻找一个新的世界，现在还不算太晚。
items.author: Alfred Tennyson

items.translation_zh: 永恒，由一个个此刻组成。
items.author: Emily Dickinson

items.original: I exist as I am, that is enough.
items.translation_zh: 我如我所是，这已经足够。
items.author: Walt Whitman

items.translation_zh: 我们的疑虑常会背叛我们。
items.author: William Shakespeare

items.original: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
items.translation_zh: 没有什么魅力能与温柔的心相比。
items.author: Jane Austen

items.original: Only that day dawns to which we are awake.
items.translation_zh: 只有我们真正醒着的那一天，才会迎来黎明。
items.author: Henry David Thoreau

items.original: The brain is wider than the sky.
items.author: Emily Dickinson

items.original: It is sufficient then in this act also to do well what we have in hand.
items.translation_zh: 在此刻，把手边之事做好就已经足够。
items.author: Marcus Aurelius

items.original: Take pleasure in one thing and rest in it.
items.translation_zh: 在一件事中安住，并从中获得宁静。
items.author: Marcus Aurelius
